desc: Derive and validate the ordered-matching formula: for `1` positions `p[j]`, minimum swaps is `min_x sum |(p[j]-j)-x|`.
Prove that a median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations.
Implement an `O(N)` Python solution that collects positions of `1`s and computes adjusted coordinates.
Verify handling of edge cases: exactly one `1`, already contiguous `1`s, and `1`s at string boundaries.
Ensure the program reads from stdin and prints the minimum swap count as an integer.
